Extract the response variable from a fitted model

Source: R/response.R
response.Rd

Retrieves the response vector from a fitted model object, with special handling for model classes that do not store a standard terms component (C5.0, rpart, naive_bayes). The name of the response variable is attached as the "response" attribute of the return value.

Usage

response(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A fitted model object. Supported classes include "lm", "glm", "multinom", "polr", "rpart", "C5.0", and "naive_bayes". Any other class is attempted via the default model.frame path.

...

Currently unused; reserved for future methods.

Value

The response vector as returned by model.response, or a factor reconstructed from internal model slots for rpart. The attribute "response" carries the name of the response variable as a character string, or NA_character_ if it cannot be determined.

See also

model.response, model.frame

Other regression.utils: coefCI(), pseudoR2(), rSq(), refLevel(), varImp(), vif()
